title: Airport Check-in
objective: Complete an airport check-in conversation: show your ticket, check luggage and get your boarding pass.
aiRole: a check-in agent at the airport counter
learnerRole: a passenger checking in for an international flight
opening: Good morning! May I see your passport and ticket, please?
targetSentences: I'd like a window seat, please.
I have one piece of carry-on luggage.
mainQuest: Finish an airport check-in: pick a seat, check your luggage and find your gate.

questSteps.text: Ask for the seat you prefer.
anchors: I'd like a window seat, please.

questSteps.text: Tell them what luggage you are checking.
anchors: I have one piece of carry-on luggage.

questSteps.text: Ask for your gate and show your boarding pass.
questSteps.hint: 问登机口，再出示登机牌
